prompt: Make light 2 come on only while I'm holding buttons 1 and 2 together.
note: Extra: both buttons released -> light 2 off. The printed procedure never asserts the neither-pushed case, so a circuit lit with neither button down (e.g. the series path in parallel with a path through both N.C. contacts) would pass the reference script.

extra.cite: BK1 printed p.10 = book1.pdf PDF p.12; derived, not printed: neither pushbutton pushed. Pushbutton 2 up leaves 2X open, so the series path from + to light 2 is broken
extra.quote: It does NOT light because the connection from + to the light is broken by pushbutton 2.
